author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.26 shipped: Music following transfer repair
why: Music following was audited as broken in November: transfers fired on stale presence, did not verify the target actually played, and bounced between adjacent rooms. The operator ruled it mission critical with no shadow mode: features die when they are not switched on, so it must work on day 1.
implications: Shipped MUSIC-FOLLOWING-TRANSFER-REPAIR-1 at v5.108.26; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.26.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If the live walk (D10) shows a missed or wrong transfer, or the outcome registry shows a failure rate above the plan's bar.

refs.release_notes: Music following transfers on live BLE presence, Music Assistant first with native backup, verifies on ground truth, bounce-safe between adjacent rooms, records every transfer outcome, live knobs. Ships on, day 1.
